The `perceptual_quality_auditor` noted slight compression/noise, which is negligible. I will downgrade the artifact score slightly from the perfect 5.0 to account for the pose auditor's strong warning signal regarding the visible anatomy, even if no catastrophic melting is visually obvious to the naked eye.
